user.title: CO2 ventilation
user.description: Pick the CO2 sensors that should drive the fan, and the fan to control. Basement or other rooms you only want to watch can be left out.

data_description.co2_sensors: The fan turns on when any of these reaches the on setpoint, and off once all are below the off setpoint.
data_description.fan_entity: A switch, fan, or input boolean. With a multi-speed fan, the CO2 routine runs it at the Ventilation speed you pick (low by default).
data_description.startup_delay: After Home Assistant restarts, wait this long for sensors to report, then turn the fan off unless CO2 is already above the on setpoint.

thermostat.name: Thermostat (optional)
thermostat.description: For the thermostat history card and the fan runtime counters. The four call inputs are the 24 V thermostat signals, for example from an ESPHome board at the air handler.

error.no_sensors: Pick at least one CO2 sensor.

abort.already_configured: CO2 Ventilation is already set up for this fan. To change sensors or settings, open the integration and choose Configure.
